Go 1.26 Release Notes - The Go Programming Language
The latest Go release, version 1.26, arrives in February 2026, six months after Go 1.25. Most of its changes are in the implementation of the toolchain, runtime, and libraries. As always, the release maintains the Go 1 promise of compatibility.
